scenarios.name: 1. Legitimate bank conversation
scenarios.recommended_action: Safe communication protocol verified. For any account or KYC updates, always visit your local bank branch in person at your convenience. Continue the safe practice of never disclosing OTPs.

scenarios.name: 3. Government-authority impersonation
scenarios.recommended_action: Disconnect the phone call immediately. Do not stay on the line. Never transfer money to alleged 'safety accounts' or scan QR codes. Call National Cybercrime Helpline 1930 immediately if money was transferred. Inform a family member or trusted neighbor right away.

scenarios.name: 9. Secrecy and isolation tactics
scenarios.recommended_action: Pause before taking any action. Do not rush into making payments or decisions due to deadlines. Hang up, look up the official phone number printed on your utility bill or bank card, and verify independently. Consult a trusted family member before proceeding.

scenarios.name: 11. Ambiguous conversation
scenarios.recommended_action: Remain vigilant. This conversation is too brief or ambiguous to determine intent. Do not volunteer personal banking details, Aadhaar numbers, or passwords. Ask the caller to send an official written notice if they represent an institution.

methodology_notes: Evaluated on 17 synthetic benchmark scenarios covering English, Hindi, Telugu, and mixed code.
Threat class defined as HIGH_RISK or SUSPICIOUS; Non-threat defined as LOW_RISK or INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE.
Naive keyword baseline flags any mention of 'otp', 'bank', 'money', 'account', 'police'.
Metrics reflect performance on this synthetic dataset and should not be construed as real-world field benchmarks.
